decisive_items: Heart rates were between 150 and 190 beats per minute
Grouped beating pattern with 1 P wave producing 2 QRS complexes, creating a regularly irregular rhythm
episodes of light-headedness and chest pain
response.rationale: Acute presentation and ECG findings indicate a tachyarrhythmia (likely 2:1 AV block) causing hemodynamic symptoms; endocarditis is the underlying cause but not the immediate diagnosis.

rejected.why: Describes causal mechanism (IVDU-related endocarditis) rather than the acute arrhythmic presentation.
Only hypotension and back pain are cited; no fever, leukocytosis, or other sepsis-defining criteria are present.
